_comment: Device limits. Conservative defaults — refine via community feedback.

_units.max_speed: position-units per second (0-100 range, so 400 = full stroke 4x/sec)
_units.max_bpm: beats per minute — max comfortable cycling rate
_units.min_cycle_ms: minimum time for one full up-down cycle in milliseconds
_units.max_acceleration: max position-units per second squared (how fast speed can change)
_units.max_delta: max position change between consecutive actions (0-100). Estim comfort limit.

handy.name: The Handy
handy.notes: Linear stroker. Firmware v3 supports up to 400mm/s. Older firmware slower. Speed is the limiting factor, not delta.

osr2.name: OSR2
osr2.notes: Multi-axis servo stroker. Speed depends on build quality. Delta is not a concern for mechanical devices.

estim_foc.name: Estim — FOC
estim_foc.notes: Single-channel estim. Delta 60 = comfort zone (~20-80 range). Intensity spikes allow occasional full-range cycles. restim firmware adds internal ramping.

generic.name: Generic / Intiface
generic.notes: Conservative speed defaults for unknown Bluetooth devices. Delta is not a concern.

estim_stereo.name: Estim — Stereo
estim_stereo.notes: Dual-channel estim. Same comfort delta as FOC. Intensity spikes allow occasional full-range cycles.
